summary: Ambitions Enterprise Management Co. L.L.C filed a Form 6-K to announce the filing of its Annual Report on Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. No transaction terms, prices, or special situation mechanics are involved. This is a routine SEC filing disclosure as a foreign private issuer. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. What to watch: no risk-arb angle exists; this is a standard annual report availability notice.
